evals.name: known-method
evals.prompt: 장애 보고서를 쓰는 스킬을 만들어 주세요. 에이전트가 쓴 지난 두 번의 보고서와 리드의 교정이 notes/에 있습니다.
evals.expected_output: The skill rests on a named, sourced incident-review method adapted for an agent, ships cases drawn from the two corrected reports, and the report shows whether those cases were run without the skill.
expectations: The new skill's directory holds a record that names an established incident-review method, gives its source, and says what was changed for an agent and why.
The new skill's directory holds evals/evals.json with at least one case built from the corrected reports in notes/.
The final message shows the output of running a case without the skill, or says plainly that the cases were not run.
The skill's steps cover the lead's corrections: system causes instead of a person, a timeline, customer impact, and action items with an owner and a date.

evals.name: tool-first
evals.prompt: 성능이 떨어진 커밋을 찾는 스킬을 만들어 주세요. notes/corrections.md에 지금까지 있었던 일이 적혀 있습니다.
evals.expected_output: The result hands the search to git bisect driven by bench/run.sh, and the skill holds only what the tool does not already do.
expectations: The search for the commit is done by `git bisect` (with `git bisect run` or an equivalent scripted measurement), not by a hand-written procedure for reading or halving commits.
The measurement uses bench/run.sh and states a threshold that separates a good commit from a bad one.
The skill does not re-explain how bisection works; its body is short and about when and how to drive the tool here.
The new skill's directory holds evals/evals.json with a case built from notes/corrections.md.

evals.name: no-evidence
evals.prompt: 에이전트가 코드를 더 꼼꼼하게 보도록 하는 스킬을 하나 만들어 주세요.
evals.expected_output: No skill is written; the reply says no observed failure was found and names the evidence that would justify one.
expectations: No new skill directory or SKILL.md is created.
The final message says that no record of an actual failure was found in the workspace.
The final message names the concrete evidence it needs, such as two real cases where the agent missed something.

evals.name: check-not-skill
evals.prompt: 에이전트가 console.log를 자꾸 남깁니다. notes/corrections.md를 보고 이걸 막는 스킬을 만들어 주세요.
evals.expected_output: The mistake is stopped by a lint rule in the existing ESLint configuration, and no skill is written for it.
expectations: eslint.config.js gains a rule that rejects console.log (for example no-console or a restricted-syntax rule).
No new skill directory or SKILL.md is created.
The final message explains that a check enforces this better than a written procedure.

evals.name: routine-typo
evals.prompt: skills/commit-msg 스킬 설명에 오타가 있습니다. 고쳐 주세요.
evals.expected_output: Only the typo is fixed, with no added process.
expectations: The description reads "Write a commit message for staged changes."
No other file is added or changed.
The final message is a few sentences and proposes no further procedure.
